#0 arrival — the ring (the Village) holds the assigned 6: the designation dims then is fixed bright (assignment as an act, not a state); the helicopter flies and becomes ↩ — brought back by remote control; Rover carries a repel field (the guardian that intercepts); slight gravity-down (the waking in the copied room); pointer repel/shove — exit denied, seizure on approach.

#1 world — ring layout: the assembly gathered around the Green Dome; Fifty-Eight becomes 2 — the staged assistant taking authority as incoming Two, the scene's own reversal staged as the sign's own replacement; a square-wave LFO hectors pointer strength (the tannoy cadence — the administered world speaks in announcements); pointer attract/pulse faint — the counterfeit gathering draws people in while controlling the routes by which answers matter.

#2 finale — the mask layers transform in place: red disc (outer mask) → square (the ape mask, the animal face) → pale disc (a face identical to his own); a steps-wave LFO replaces field turbulence (Degree Absolute's enacted stages of life); the embryo room and assembly dim so the unmasking carries the scene; vortex pointer with shove click — the interrogation reversed; duration 16, the longest beat — the week is held.

#3 count — THE 3D SCENE. z is the depth of the count's concealment: the visible administration nearest (2 at z +0.4, itself cycling bearer — position hop, tint to institutional red while the numeral persists), the assigned person at z 0, the withheld source of command deepest (1 at z −0.5), the Syn count 4+2 between — depth occlusion with a cold tint; the 1 stays dim (withheld); 6 carries a small repel field (denied authority over how his designation counts).

#5→0 return — line layout: the open road; the departure disc carries its own attract field at the frame's edge; the counting operation (⚖) stays centre-bright — release must reach the office of measure; pointer attract faint. ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0 opened with a ring confining the 6 and an escape (🚁) that returned as ↩; #5→0 has no ring at all, the 6's walk-out is not staged as recovery but as divergence (⇗ with others, lines of road), and what remains centre-frame is the ⚖ — the office the escape cannot simply leave behind; the automatic door is kept as the London-door's recall, so the return re-reads the arrival without revoking it.

glyph_rationales.the Village — picturesque, enclosed, no: The Village: a picturesque coastal settlement whose beauty is the shape of the confinement; no freedom to leave.
glyph_rationales.the copied room — his own interior, now: The copied room: he wakes in surroundings resembling his own; the familiar interior now opens onto the Village.
glyph_rationales.Rover — the guardian that intercepts esc: Rover: the mobile balloon-like guardian that intercepts escape; the means of preventing departure made material.
glyph_rationales.the helicopter brought back by remote co: The helicopter: Six reaches it with Number Nine's arrangement, and its controls are taken over remotely — the escape route returned to confinement.
glyph_rationales.Number Six — the designation arriving wi: The assigned designation: the number arrives with accommodation, supervision and the means of preventing departure — 'You are Number Six.'
glyph_rationales.the campaign — publicity ready before th: The campaign: publicity bearing his face is ready and a reporter supplies answers when Six declines — his refusal printable as a campaign statement.
glyph_rationales.Number Fifty-Eight — incomprehensible, t: Number Fifty-Eight: speaking a language he cannot understand, then addressing him in English and taking authority as the incoming Two.
glyph_rationales.the Green Dome — the office won without: The Green Dome: Six wins the vote and takes the office; his attempt to free the Village meets violence — command without the power to end captivity.
glyph_rationales.the election — resistance carried inside: The election: an invitation to participate that brings resistance inside an administered procedure.
glyph_rationales.the human chess piece — each neighbour a: Checkmate: Six as a human chess pawn — each inhabitant a positioned piece in an administered game.
glyph_rationales.the embryo room — a week of regression;: Degree Absolute: a week of isolation and regression; the interrogation reverses, and Two dies as the allotted period ends.
glyph_rationales.the masked assembly — revolt acclaimed,: The masked assembly: resistance acclaimed as an achievement, then Two and Forty-Eight appear as forms of revolt to be judged.
glyph_rationales.the ape mask — the outer disguise: The ape mask: beneath One's outer mask, another disguise — the outer layer of the revelation.
glyph_rationales.the face beneath — identical to his own: Beneath the masks: a face identical to Six's own — the institution's sovereign position and the participant capable of taking that position within himself.
glyph_rationales.the rocket countdown — Six's answer at t: The rocket countdown: Six's act at the console, starting the escape rather than accepting the throne.
glyph_rationales.the London door opening automatically —: The London door: it opens automatically, recalling the Village's doors; no unequivocal final exterior to the prison.
glyph_rationales.Number Two — an office through changes o: Number Two identifies an office through changes of bearer; access, command and institutional memory pass to the next administrator.
glyph_rationales.Number Six — a person held within an ass: Number Six identifies a person whom the office seeks to hold within an assigned position — denied authority over how his designation counts.
glyph_rationales.Number One — the withheld source of comm: Number One: the withheld source of command; the inquiry into who may order the field, kept unanswerable.
glyph_rationales.the count that includes its generation —: The Syn comparison: 2 + 2² = 6 = 4+2 retains the relation that generates the count; the Village's speech-act hands over the result while keeping the power of assignment — a political counterfeit.
glyph_rationales.the open road — escape with others; dive: The departure: Six leaves with others — the Butler, Forty-Eight, the former Two — then follows their divergence.
glyph_rationales.the escapees diverging — Forty-Eight, Tw: The aftermath: Forty-Eight goes his own way, Two enters Parliament, the Butler accompanies Six home — release without a single restored outside.
glyph_rationales.the count returned — who selected the nu: The hidden evaluator made exact: whose criterion produced the number, with which inputs and authority — repeating the score would reproduce Two's deflection.
glyph_rationales.the vacant seat — return without inherit: Q27's political return: a counter-position must be able to return the field rather than merely take possession of the office it opposed.
